text: {"label":"Training Caregivers, Staff, and Autistic Adults","definition":"Studies of behavioral skills training and technology-based or brief training programs that teach parents and staff to deliver autism interventions, and that teach vocational, interview, and social skills to autistic adolescents and adults.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on training the adults who deliver interventions and on teaching job-related skills to older autistic individuals, not on skill-acquisition procedures, social skills teaching, or intervention outcomes for young children."}
